title: Planar-push task supplement (Task 2: rebut circular-symmetry tailoring)
env_note: One env, two arms distinguished by the goal_heading flag: heading_push (block aligns position AND heading) and free_yaw_push (block aligns position only, heading free). The env is a NEW @register_env class in its own file; frozen SE(2)/SE(3) classes are byte-identical.
orientation_note: Q1 identity only (table normal = world z). du/dv are in-plane translation, yaw is heading about the table normal (all TRACKED); dw is vertical translation, roll/pitch are tilts (all SUPPRESSED — the block stays on the table, level).
task_anchor_note: Nominal ghost-target centre at block-centre height (z = BLOCK_HALF_Z = 0.01). The ghost renders the full 6-DOF target at C0 o intervention, so dw/roll/pitch genuinely vary in the data (necessary for the model to learn alpha=0 vs alpha=1). Block starts at a FIXED pose (-0.10, 0.0, 0.01).

gripper.note: Firm gripper (unchanged from rotated-axis / symmetry-transfer / SE(3)).

heading_push.solver: solve_planar_push (guided push / grasp + slide: reach overhead grasp -> push lift+slide to target in-plane position -> align wrist yaw about the table normal in bounded 0.05 rad closed-loop steps -> retract lower+release; the block's heading is set by rotating the grasped block)
heading_push.note: du/dv/yaw tracked (block responds to target in-plane pose), dw/roll/pitch suppressed (block on table).

free_yaw_push.solver: solve_planar_push (guided push / grasp + slide; heading NEVER corrected, block stays at its grasp heading 0)
free_yaw_push.note: du/dv tracked, yaw suppressed too (block never rotates; heading free).

oracle.note: du/dv respond from push on; yaw (heading) responds from align on; dw/roll/pitch never respond. reach/retract are setup/teardown (block at rest) and are masked from threshold scoring. The SELECTOR (which generators are ever tracked) is static: {du,dv,yaw} vs {dw,roll,pitch} — a second contrast against peg-in-hole's phase-dependent yaw drop.

contexts.manifest: 75-condition frozen manifest (60 mixed + 14 isolated + 1 baseline), IDENTICAL 6-vectors to the frozen peg-in-hole manifest
contexts.isolated_grid: du/dv/dw at +-0.015 m; roll/pitch at +-15 deg; yaw at +-15 and +-30 deg
contexts.demonstrations: N in {8, 15, 30} mixed demos, subsampled from the 60-mixed manifest via a FROZEN subset file (planar_push_subsets.json). N>=6 is required for a rank-6 design.

frozen_model.finite_action: C0 Exp(P(s) Log(C0^-1 C)) C0^-1 X0 in SE(3), 6-dim diagonal
frozen_model.suite: SE3FrameWeightedModel / SE3FullOperatorModel / SE3DiagonalOperatorModel / SE3SmoothFinitePDiagModel, REUSED byte-identical from phase_switch_se3_baselines.py

success_criteria.M_oop_out_of_plane_suppression: HEADLINE. For heading_push: correct iff max-active alpha_j < 0.5 for all of {dw, roll, pitch} AND max-active alpha_j > 0.5 for all of {du, dv, yaw}, where active phases = push+align and the max is taken over active phases (robust to the one-phase support offset: du/dv onset at push, yaw onset at align). Target ~100% for Pdiag finite across seeds/subsets at N in {8,15,30}; near 0 for the Frame-weighted negative control.
success_criteria.M1_generator_identification_error: E_alpha(arm; N, model) = (1/(6T)) sum_j sum_t (alpha_j(t) - alpha*_j^arm(t))^2 against the full phasewise oracle above.
success_criteria.M_yaw_heading_vs_free_yaw: Correct iff alpha_yaw_active_max(heading_push) > 0.5 AND alpha_yaw_active_max(free_yaw_push) < 0.5. Target 100% for Pdiag finite at every N.
success_criteria.cross_task_out_of_plane_contrast: alpha_{dw,roll,pitch} in heading_push (~0) vs the frozen peg-in-hole keyed arm (~1) — read directly from the frozen se3_transfer_fits.csv + the new fits. No new collection.

collection_policy.contexts_note: The push manifest reuses intervention_rows_se3 (same seed), so its 75 causal_deltas are byte-identical to the frozen peg-in-hole manifest — the cross-task contrast holds interventions fixed across tasks.
collection_policy.env_change_note: One NEW @register_env class (PlanarPush-v1) in its own file; frozen SE(2)/SE(3) classes and their provenance hashes are byte-for-byte preserved.
collection_policy.phase0_gate: A feasibility probe (probe_planar_push.py) must pass BEFORE full collection: the scripted pusher must reach the target across context extremes (far targets, +-30 deg heading, ghost tilted +-15 deg). RESULT: the initial non-prehensive point-push reached the target position reliably (baseline/du/dv/diag all pos_err ~0.007) but its align-phase corner-nudge yaw control was unstable and out of reach (IK failed at +-30 deg heading). Per this gate, the solver was SWITCHED to guided push (grasp + slide), which passes 14/14 probe cases across both arms (heading_push 7/7, free_yaw_push 7/7).

solver_fix.what: The align-phase wrist-yaw rotation was changed from a single rotation by the full heading residual (<=3 closed-loop passes) to a closed-loop sequence of bounded 0.05 rad steps (<=60 passes).
solver_fix.why: Post-collection data audit found the original align rotation occasionally levered the grasped block OFF the table (block z reached 0.70 m, pitch/roll ~0.75 rad) in a rare (~2-3/50 align episodes, seed-dependent) physics instability. This out-of-plane motion is spuriously attributed to the suppressed dw generator by the Pdiag finite model at N=30 (alpha_dw 0.106 -> 0.771), degrading the headline M_oop (heading_push) to 0.389. Bounded steps keep the block level (z span ~0.002 m) while still reaching the heading.
solver_fix.scope: SOLVER-only change (collect_planar_push_rollouts.py). The frozen env (phase_switch_symmetry_planar_push_env.py) is byte-identical, and the context manifest, subsets, model suite, and oracle are unchanged.
solver_fix.validation: heading_push was re-collected (all 3 seeds, 75/75 success). Post-fix align-phase block z max is 0.0255 m across every align-present episode (0 episodes with z>0.05), versus 5 episodes exceeding 0.69 m in the original collection. The Phase-0 gate re-passed 14/14 with the fixed solver.
solver_fix.recollection_note: Only heading_push was re-collected (its align phase is the only place the rotation runs). free_yaw_push has no align rotation and its original clean data is unchanged.
